reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 纸故事工坊的五个确认

materials.title: Paper Story Workshop 015
materials.text:
At the paper-story workshop, choose the reply that fits each question. Use each reply once.
A. With the paper fox.
B. Next to the window.
C. It is Eva’s.
D. At five o’clock.
E. No, we use glue.

questions.prompt: Who does the little paper bird play with?
questions.explanation: A与纸狐狸玩回答with谁；B位置、C物主、D时间、E是否用胶均不答同伴。

questions.prompt: Where shall we put the finished story board?
questions.explanation: B窗边答作品放处；A同伴、C物主、D时刻、E用胶答句均不答Where。

questions.prompt: Whose name is on this small paper house?
questions.explanation: C Eva的回答姓名归属；A纸狐同伴、B位置、D时间、E胶水均不答Whose。

questions.prompt: When does the workshop finish?
questions.explanation: D五点结束回答时间；A同伴、B位置、C物主、E用胶否定不答When。

questions.prompt: Do we use tape to join the paper trees?
questions.explanation: E不用胶带改胶水，回应Do we use tape；A同伴、B位置、C物主、D时间均不答制作材料的是否选择。

materials.title: Drinking Station Line 015
materials.text: At the water station, stand behind the yellow line. Fill your bottle, then move to the blue arrow. Do not stop there to drink. The drinking seats are under the tree. Leave the bottle caps on the clean shelf while filling. Tell the helper if the tap keeps running.

questions.prompt: A friend stands in front of the yellow line while waiting. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A候水黄线后；B水龙头上、C插队均不合排队要求。

questions.prompt: A friend has a full bottle and stays at the tap. You say, "____"
options: Leave your bottle on the ground.
questions.explanation: B装好沿蓝箭头离开；A重复灌无需；C地上放瓶非疏离步骤。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to drink at the blue arrow. You say, "____"
options: Use a seat under the tree.
questions.explanation: C饮水座在树下，箭头不驻足；A堵路违规则；B清架放瓶盖非坐躺。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a bottle cap in the mud. You say, "____"
options: Put it on the clean shelf.
Put it in the running tap.
questions.explanation: A瓶盖干净架；B龙头内、C鞋下均非洁净存处。

questions.prompt: Water keeps running after use. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B持续流水报帮助者；A不报告相反；C午饭堵水非处理方法。

materials.title: Toy Railway Tracks 015
materials.text: We build a toy railway on a mat. Join the track pieces before putting the train on them. Keep the bridge low. The tall blocks are for the station, not the bridge. Leave a gap at the mat edge so feet can pass. The red engine pulls only two carriages.

questions.prompt: A friend puts the train on loose track pieces. You say, "____"
options: Put the train on your head.
questions.explanation: A先接轨再放车；B拆散相反；C头部不是轨道。

questions.prompt: A friend makes the bridge very tall. You say, "____"
options: Put the bridge inside the engine.
questions.explanation: B桥保持低；A更高违要求；C发动机内非桥位。

questions.prompt: A friend takes the tall blocks for the bridge. You say, "____"
options: Use those blocks for the station.
questions.explanation: C高积木给站房；A高块存在；B丢弃非分配。

questions.prompt: A friend fills the gap at the mat edge. You say, "____"
options: Leave room for feet to pass.
Move the railway onto the stairs.
questions.explanation: A垫边留脚通过；B全堵相反；C楼梯未作场地。

questions.prompt: A friend adds a third carriage to the red engine. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B红机最多两车厢，第三超限；A再加更超；C不需取消机车。

materials.title: Sandwich Box Switch 015
materials.text: At lunch, I open a blue box. There is a cheese sandwich inside. I brought an egg sandwich today, so I know it is not my box. A name under the lid says "Milo". I close it and ask the teacher for help. Milo has my blue box. We swap them before eating. Next time, I will check the name before opening the lid.

questions.prompt: The writer brought a cheese sandwich today.
questions.explanation: B正确：作者带egg，错盒是cheese；A交换食物归属。

questions.prompt: The wrong box has Milo’s name under the lid.
questions.explanation: A正确：name under lid says Milo；B否认识别证据。

questions.prompt: The writer starts eating before finding the owner.
questions.explanation: B正确：合盖求助，交换后才吃；A颠倒顺序。

questions.prompt: Both lunch boxes are blue.
questions.explanation: A正确：先错拿blue box，Milo持my blue box；B否认同色导致易混信息。

questions.prompt: The writer plans to check the name before opening next time.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句明确下一次改进；B否认计划。

materials.title: Tent Night Shadows 015
materials.text: We camp in the garden. At night, I see a big shadow on the tent. It looks like a giant hand. I feel afraid. Dad looks outside. A small branch is moving in front of our lamp. He moves the lamp to another place. The big shadow goes away. I touch the little branch in the morning and laugh. It is no bigger than my own hand.

questions.prompt: The family camps in the garden.
questions.explanation: A正确：camp in garden；B否认场地。

questions.prompt: A real giant puts a hand on the tent.
questions.explanation: B正确：枝条与灯产生影，looks like不等于真巨人；A把外观误作事实。

questions.prompt: Dad finds a branch in front of the lamp.
questions.explanation: A正确：branch moving in front lamp；B否认原因。

questions.prompt: Dad cuts down the whole tree to remove the shadow.
questions.explanation: B正确：移灯后影消失；A虚构砍树。

questions.prompt: The branch is bigger than the writer’s hand.
questions.explanation: B正确：no bigger than my hand；A把不大于说成更大。

materials.title: Snowman Scarf Return 015
materials.text: My sister puts her red scarf on our snowman. The sun comes out in the afternoon. The snowman gets smaller, and the scarf falls into the snow. I pick it up. It is cold and wet. I take it inside and put it over a chair near the door. In the morning, it is dry. I give it back to my sister before she goes to school.

questions.prompt: The snowman wears the sister’s red scarf.
questions.explanation: A正确：sister red scarf on snowman；B否认物主与颜色。

questions.prompt: The snowman grows bigger in the afternoon sun.
questions.explanation: B正确：gets smaller；A将变小改大。

questions.prompt: The scarf is dry when it first falls.
questions.explanation: B正确：捡起时cold and wet；A提前说干。

questions.prompt: The writer puts the scarf over a chair indoors.
questions.explanation: A正确：inside over chair near door；B否认晾放处。

questions.prompt: The scarf is returned before the sister leaves for school.
questions.explanation: A正确：before goes school归还；B否认明确先后。

materials.title: Class Cake Cool Time 015
materials.text: In baking club, our group makes small cakes. The recipe says to let them cool before adding soft icing. We put the tray on a safe table. A pupil wants to decorate the cakes at once because the lesson ends soon. The helper asks us to wait ten minutes. Meanwhile, we draw labels for the cake boxes. When the cakes are cool, the icing stays on top instead of running off. We take the boxes home, but we leave the hot tray for the adult helper to clean.

questions.prompt: When should icing be added?
options: While the tray is in the oven.
questions.explanation: A食谱先冷后涂；B烤前、C炉中均非步骤。

questions.prompt: Why does one pupil want to decorate at once?
questions.explanation: B课将结束赶时间；A有糖霜；C起初仍需冷却。

questions.prompt: What does the group do while waiting?
questions.explanation: C等时画盒标签；A成人清热器具且无独清炉；B没全吃。

questions.prompt: What happens when icing is put on cool cakes?
questions.explanation: A冷后停留顶面；B变盒、C流进炉都非原文。

questions.prompt: Who handles the hot tray after the lesson?
questions.explanation: B热盘留成人清；A最幼学生、C校外访客均未安排。

materials.title: Bridge Model Labels 015
materials.text: Our class builds two paper bridges. Each uses one sheet of paper. Bridge A is flat. Bridge B has folds. We place coins on them one at a time and record when each bends. A visitor says Bridge B must always be stronger. The teacher says our test shows only what happened with these two models. One fold was not straight, so we will make another model and test again. We keep the first results on the board with a note about the crooked fold.

questions.prompt: Both models use one sheet of paper each.
questions.explanation: A正确：each one sheet；B否认相同用纸量。

questions.prompt: Bridge A has folds and Bridge B is flat.
questions.explanation: B正确：A平B折；A互换模型特征。

questions.prompt: Coins are added one at a time.
questions.explanation: A正确：one at a time；B否认测试步骤。

questions.prompt: The teacher says one trial proves every folded bridge is always stronger.
questions.explanation: B正确：限这两模型结果，不做always推广；A夸大结论。

questions.prompt: The first results remain with a note about the crooked fold.
questions.explanation: A正确：keep results with note；B否认记录保留。

materials.title: Festival Sound Zone 015
materials.text:
Festival programme
Music stage: courtyard, 13:00–14:00. Group performances; no visitor instruments on stage.
Quiet stories: Room 4, 13:30–14:30. Small-group reading; enter between stories when a helper opens the door.
Making corner: covered walkway, 13:00–15:00. Drop in to make paper flowers. Materials provided while supplies last.
Please keep the passage to Room 4 clear. The courtyard loudspeaker faces away from the classrooms, but some sound may still be heard. Visitors needing a quieter place can ask at the information desk. Children remain with their accompanying adult in all zones.

questions.prompt: Which activity lasts two hours?
questions.explanation: D13至15两小时；A和B各一小时；C无讲座项目。

questions.prompt: When may visitors enter Quiet stories?
options: Between stories when the helper opens the door.
Before the event the previous day.
questions.explanation: A故事间由帮助者开门进；B任时打断违规则；C/D非规定时段。

questions.prompt: Which rule applies at the music stage?
options: Visitors may bring any instrument onto it.
Only scheduled group performances use it.
It is the entrance to Room 4.
Paper flowers must be made on it.
questions.explanation: B舞台用于节目中的团体演出且无访客乐器；A与no visitor instruments相反；C入口、D纸花场所均与对应区域不符。

questions.prompt: What does the programme say about sound from the courtyard?
options: It cannot reach any classroom under any condition.
Some sound may still be heard.
questions.explanation: C朝外仍可能闻；A绝对无声夸大；B扬声器仍使用；D无此声源判断。

questions.prompt: What should visitors do if they need somewhere quieter?
options: Enter the stage with an instrument.
questions.explanation: A咨询台可求较静处；B堵通道明禁；C乐器上台违限；D拿光材料无关。

units.title: 动物收容所的毯子清单

materials.title: Animal Shelter Blankets 015
materials.text: Our school collected blankets for an animal shelter. The shelter asked for clean, washable blankets with no loose threads. Some families brought thick quilts. They looked warm, but the shelter’s washing machine was too small for them. Volunteers checked each donation against the list instead of judging only by appearance. Suitable blankets went into blue boxes. Other items were returned politely with an explanation or passed to a different charity after the donor agreed. The school’s report counted accepted blankets separately from the total number of items brought in. This prevented the collection total from suggesting that every donation had reached the shelter.

questions.prompt: The shelter requested blankets that could be washed.
questions.explanation: A正确：clean washable且无松线；B否认要求。

questions.prompt: Every warm-looking quilt suited the shelter’s washing machine.
questions.explanation: B正确：厚被机容量不够；A把看着暖当全适用。

questions.prompt: Volunteers checked the written requirements.
questions.explanation: A正确：against list非只看外观；B否认核对。

questions.prompt: Unsuitable items were sent to another charity without asking donors.
questions.explanation: B正确：after donor agreed；A忽略同意条件。

questions.prompt: The report distinguished accepted blankets from all donated items.
questions.explanation: A正确：accepted separately total；B否认统计边界。

units.title: 鸟类观察记录的缺测日

materials.title: School Bird Count Window 015
materials.text:
For a bird-count project, pupils observed the same playground tree for ten minutes at lunch each day. They wrote down birds they could clearly identify. On Wednesday, a heavy shower kept everyone indoors. One member entered zero in the table because no birds had been written down. Another pointed out that zero could mean someone had looked and seen no birds. On Wednesday, no observation had been made at all.
The team changed that cell to "not observed" and explained the rain. On Friday, they did watch the tree for ten minutes and saw no birds, so zero remained correct for that day. The report kept these two cases separate. Members also noted that they could count only visible birds during the chosen minutes. Their figures did not show every bird that used the tree at other times.

questions.prompt: What was the usual observation period?
questions.explanation: A午餐十分钟；B通宵、C黎明一分钟、D每小时不停均无据。

questions.prompt: Why was zero unsuitable for Wednesday?
options: The team saw hundreds of birds.
Rain always removes all birds from a town.
questions.explanation: B未观测不等于观测到零；A无大群所见；C有数表；D绝对无鸟无依据。

questions.prompt: Why was zero kept for Friday?
options: They observed and saw no birds.
They wanted equal values every day.
questions.explanation: C实际看十分钟未见；A和B未发生；D不是追求数值一致。

questions.prompt: What did the report distinguish?
options: Red birds from all other animals only.
Old trees from new trees only.
Missing observation from an observed zero.
questions.explanation: D缺测与观测零分开；A/C分类非主旨；B衣服无关。

questions.prompt: What limit did the pupils state?
options: The counts covered only visible birds during set periods.
They had measured every bird’s full life.
All birds used only that tree.
No future observation would be useful.
questions.explanation: A可见和固定时段限制；B全生命、C全鸟唯一树、D未来无价值均夸大。

units.title: 校园短剧字幕的一次核对

materials.title: Drama Subtitle Revision 015
materials.text:
The drama club added English subtitles to a short film. A speech tool produced the first draft. It turned the character’s line "Wait by the gate" into "Wait by the lake." The sentence still sounded sensible, so a quick spelling check did not catch it. Two pupils compared the subtitles with the recorded speech and the script. They corrected the place name and several speaker labels.
Another line was not clear in the recording, and the script had changed during filming. The club asked the actor what had been said instead of guessing from the tool’s output. After checking, they kept a note of the correction. The final credits thanked the pupil reviewers as well as naming the software used. The club said that a fluent-looking draft still needed checking against the actual work.

questions.prompt: The first subtitle draft came from a speech tool.
questions.explanation: A正确：speech tool produced first draft；B否认来源。

questions.prompt: The mistaken place name was obvious to a spelling check because it was not a real word.
questions.explanation: B正确：lake为真实词且拼检未发现；A误称非词且明显。

questions.prompt: Pupils checked both the recording and the script.
questions.explanation: A正确：compared with recorded speech and script；B否认双来源核查。

questions.prompt: For an unclear changed line, the club relied only on the tool’s guess.
questions.explanation: B正确：询演员确认非猜工具输出；A把求证说成独用工具。

questions.prompt: The credits recognised the human reviewers’ work.
questions.explanation: A正确：感谢pupil reviewers并列软件；B否认人工贡献说明。
